items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I know that Benny Murtoff had a theater in the West Side

ctx.x: Yeah. So I mean it's kind of -- the Public Circle was the whole thing in the Chicago, they were outlying cities, they thought maybe they're going to have maybe -- I don't really know the number, but I know that Benny Murtoff had a theater in the West Side, Benny Kruger, oh different theaters, all around Chicago.
